name: Run a review from the PR page (mock LLM): live progress, then findings
description: Needs the API on the deterministic mock LLM (LLM_PROVIDER_OVERRIDE=mock, set by scripts/e2e.sh together with E2E_MOCK_LLM) — skipped otherwise. PR #482 → Agent runs → Run Review ▾ → Security Reviewer. The POST starts one run; while the mock call sleeps (LLM_MOCK_DELAY_MS) the Live review section ('Review in progress…') is on screen; when the run ends it disappears and the new review (newest, open by default) shows the mock's two grounded findings on src/middleware/ratelimit.ts, and the timeline gets a tile with their severity counters. WRITES (a run + review) — the hermetic stack reseeds every run.
